questions.question: The student wants to challenge the model used in Danielsdottir et al.’s study. Which choice most effectively uses information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Since it classifies plankton as exclusively phototrophic producers or phagotrophic consumers, the model used in Danielsdottir et al.’s study may misrepresent planktonic ecosystems, in which—as Stoecker et al. note—many plankton combine these functions. 21% 选择

Danielsdottir et al.’s model disregards the respective roles of producers and consumers—organisms that, as Stoecker et al. emphasize, are essential to the trophic structure of the planktonfood web. 6% 选择

By restricting plankton functional types to phytoplankton and zooplankton, the model used in Danielsdottir et al.’s study of planktonic ecosystems overlooks the many mixotrophic species that combine phototrophic and phagotrophic nutrition. 正确选项 68% 选择

Stoecker et al. (2017) note that NPZ models rely on the differentiation of planktonic communities into phytoplankton or zooplankton functional types, which is exactly the approach used in Danielsdottir et al.’s 2007 study. 5% 选择
